design.uncertainty: Exploratory pilot 95% percentile intervals from independent resampling of training-model seeds and complete histories; no independent episode assumption.
design.effect_direction: Method minus reference; negative capped actions and positive success favour method.
design.cost_definition: Capped actions equal executed steps on success and max_steps on failure.
design.curve_interpretation: Descriptive completion times under the fixed max_steps policy; budgets are not separately executed policies.
design.memory_protocols: Cold online and fitted frozen memory differ in both prior experience and updating.
design.baseline_replication: Repeated deterministic baseline results across model seeds are shared observations.

interpretation: Frozen held-out pilot; no powered confirmatory or physical-robot claim.
